field.name: idGender
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_EMPLOYEE_GENDER
field.query: select idGender as value, gender as idGender from #__elg_ergasia_gender_translate where {language} order by gender

field.name: idNationality
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_CANDIDATE_NATIONALITY_LABEL
field.query: select idCountry as value, country as idNationality from #__elg_country_translation inner join #__elg_country on id = idCountry and {language} order by ordering, country

field.name: idMilitaryStatus
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_EMPLOYEE_MILITARYSTATUS_LABEL
field.query: select idMilitaryStatus as value, militaryStatus as idMilitaryStatus from #__elg_militarystatus_translation inner join #__elg_militarystatus on id = idMilitaryStatus and {language} order by ordering, militaryStatus

field.name: idMaritalStatus
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_EMPLOYEE_MARITALSTATUS_LABEL
field.query: select idMaritalStatus as value, maritalStatus as idMaritalStatus from #__elg_maritalstatus_translation inner join #__elg_maritalstatus on id = idMaritalStatus and {language} order by ordering

field.name: idPapers
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_CANDIDATE_PAPERS_LABEL
field.query: select id as value, paper as idPapers from #__elg_ergasia_papers order by ordering

field.name: idReligion
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_EMPLOYEE_RELIGION_LABEL
field.query: select idReligion as value, religion as idReligion from #__elg_religion_translation where {language} order by religion

field.name: idPetFriend
field.label: COM_ELGERGASIA_VIEW_EMPLOYEE_PET_LABEL
field.query: select idRank as value, rankFem as idPetFriend from #__elg_rank_translation where {language} order by ordering
